name: repomix
title_zh: 一份文件装下整个代码库，AI 分析不用翻目录
tagline_zh: 本地目录或 GitHub 远程仓库，一键打包成单文件。结构、模式、token 数一目了然。
tagline_en: Local folder or GitHub repo → one file. See structure, patterns, token counts. Skip the manual file-by-file prep.
desc_en: Pack and analyze codebases into AI-friendly single files using Repomix. Use when the user wants to explore repositories, analyze code structure, find patterns, check token counts, or prepare codebase context for AI analysis. Supports both local directories and remote GitHub repositories.
why_zh: 不是简单拼接源码，而是按 AI 读取习惯重组目录树与文件内容，附带 token 统计。
why_en: Not a dumb concatenator: it rebuilds tree + contents for LLM consumption, with token stats, so the model sees a structured map.
limit_zh: 只处理文本类代码文件，二进制、图片、PDF 等非文本内容会被忽略；产物是单文件文本，不含可执行逻辑。
limit_en: Text code files only; binaries, images, PDFs are skipped. Output is a single text file, no executable logic—pair it with an AI tool.
title_en: One file, whole codebase, ready for AI analysis
